content:
To maximize the middle block, take \(a_8\) as large as possible. Since \(a_8<a_9\) and \(a_8+a_9=44\), the maximum is \(a_8=21\), \(a_9=23\).

Then the largest possible five integers below \(a_8=21\) are:
\[
16,17,18,19,20
\]
These are all greater than \(a_2\), so they are valid.

Total sum:
\[
(a_1+a_2)+(16+17+18+19+20)+(a_8+a_9)
=10+90+44=144
\]
Average:
\[
\frac{144}{9}=16
\]

\boxed{16}
